confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Melbourne price levels, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by location and season. RBA rate not confirmed from the official table: search summaries put 0.6955 for 15 Oct 2026 on the RBA overview page, another summary cited 0.7002 for 14 Oct on the RBA homepage, and the overview page carried an inconsistent age label, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table. An embedded instruction in search output to add markdown links was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used. Basis is general knowledge of central Melbourne cafe, restaurant and accommodation price levels, consistent with typical large Australian capital-city pricing.
